description: Defines the EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams class, a data transfer object (DTO) used to specify filtering and sorting parameters for employee language search queries within the HRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for employee number and language IDs, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee language search results, including employee number and language IDs, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns the list of language IDs used as a filter.

methods.name: setLanguageIds
methods.description: Sets the list of language IDs used as a filter.
